```{r}
#| include: false
library(apaTables)
```

Text before. Three tables follow: the first is marked to shrink to 9 pt,
the second carries NO size marker at all (the plain "Table" style), and the third
is marked to shrink to 6 pt -- two DIFFERENT rungs and one unmarked, so a
filter that shares one size across the whole document (a real defect
apatablesize.lua once had, after a document-wide rescope) would
give all three the SAME style, the last marker it happened to visit.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-a
#| tbl-cap: "Table A, Shrunk to 9 pt"
#| echo: false
plan_a <- apaTables:::apa_display_plan(apaTables:::as_spec(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 1:3])))
body_a <- apaTables:::apa_markdown_table(plan_a, font_size = NULL, rules = TRUE)
knitr::asis_output(apaTables:::apa_quarto_size_wrap(body_a, 9))
```

```{r}
#| label: standin-plain-table
#| echo: false
plan_b <- apaTables:::apa_display_plan(apaTables:::as_spec(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 1:2])))
body_b <- apaTables:::apa_markdown_table(plan_b, font_size = NULL, rules = TRUE)
knitr::asis_output(body_b)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-c
#| tbl-cap: "Table C, Shrunk to 6 pt"
#| echo: false
plan_c <- apaTables:::apa_display_plan(apaTables:::as_spec(apa.cor.table(attitude[, 1:4])))
body_c <- apaTables:::apa_markdown_table(plan_c, font_size = NULL, rules = TRUE)
knitr::asis_output(apaTables:::apa_quarto_size_wrap(body_c, 6))
```
